faculty: Faculty of Medicine (Medicine and Surgery Program, MBBCh), East Port Said National University
overview: The Faculty of Medicine combines modern medical knowledge, practical training and scientific research, aiming for a qualitative shift in medical education through an interactive learning environment with modern technology, innovative curricula and practical training.
vision: For the Bachelor of Medicine and Surgery Program at East Port Said National University to be a leader in medical education and scientific research, grounded in community needs and capable of graduating skilled physicians who can compete in the labor market.
mission: Provide an educational system that graduates competent physicians able to meet individual and community healthcare needs locally and internationally, while supporting lifelong learning, scientific research and community service.

programs.name: Bachelor of Medicine and Surgery (MBBCh), Medicine and Surgery Program
programs.duration: 5 years over 10 semesters, followed by 2 years of compulsory internship (7 years total)
programs.credit_hours: Not found. The live page names the ECTS credit system but gives no credit-hour total.
programs.focus: Basic medical sciences, early practical and clinical skills training, clinical reasoning, scientific research and community service. Instruction is described as integrated (basic sciences, clinical training and community service). Language: English, with Arabic for patient communication.
programs.careers: Practicing physician; work in healthcare and hospital settings; medical scientific research; healthcare quality; community health; continuing medical education.

facilities.item: Laboratory training and early essential-skills training (described generically; no skills lab or simulation centre named)
Primary healthcare clinical training via medical convoys: Qatiya Primary Healthcare Unit and Al-Marih Primary Healthcare Unit (North Sinai)
Practical first-block examinations held at the university campus in Sinai (first time reported)

facilities.source: Not found in local pages 3155/10, live faculty page, posts, or web search

facilities.item: Teaching hospitals owned or run by EPNU
facilities.source: Not found. The live page and posts name no EPNU teaching hospital.

partners.item: Port Said University: EPNU joined PSU in inaugurating the new university hospital (July 2026); the post states this supports medical education and training, but names no specific training agreement
General Authority for Healthcare, Port Said branch: delegation discussed training, research and continuing medical education, and drafting a cooperation protocol (not yet signed)
Armed Forces medical college: delegation visit to strengthen medical cooperation and exchange expertise

57357 Hospital (children's cancer treatment): memorandum of understanding under discussion to support training and health cooperation. Practical training for Applied Health Sciences students, not Medicine students.
Ahl Masr (Ahl Misr) Burn Hospital: site visit and lab training for Medical Laboratory students (Applied Health Sciences, not Medicine)
Saudi German Hospital, Cairo: clinical training for Applied Health Sciences students (not Medicine)

highlights.item: Program director Dr. Sherine El-Khouly received the GAHAR professional diploma with an Excellent grade, first cohort (the diploma is personal, not program accreditation)
Seven research papers presented at a Suez Canal University medical student conference
A student research paper accepted among the top 97 papers at the 9th Ain Shams Medical School conference
Two student papers accepted at the Mansoura Faculty of Medicine (Manchester) student research conference, the university's first participation (more than 80 papers from nine faculties)
Fourth-year students presented a paper at the Sixth Annual Mansoura Manchester Student Research Conference
Fourth-year public health research graduation projects presented (topics include emergency medicine awareness and patient-safety attitudes)
Medical students took part in the 27th Annual Conference of the Port Said Society of Internal Medicine and the 11th International Pediatric Conference
Student-organised First Aid Training Workshop supervised by Dr. Sherine El-Khouly

three_slide_bullets: 5 years over 10 semesters, plus 2 years compulsory internship.
Integrated curriculum: basic sciences, clinical training, community service.
English-medium instruction under the ECTS credit system.
Early clinical skills training plus convoys at North Sinai primary care units.
Program director holds a GAHAR Excellent diploma; students publish at national conferences.
